panels.sample_scope: Supplementary Fig. 12 | Radial moisture changes and pressure-resolved boundary exchange. a,b, Temporary-minus-final contrasts in pre-event 700-hPa observed humidity, common-cell background and anomaly (a), and 0–24 h integrated horizontal advection, vertical advection, residual and moving tendency (b), for 100–300 and 300–800 km annuli. Both use 80 SID pairs. These local quantities, in g kg⁻¹, differ from layer-integrated 500–925 hPa transport in kg. c, Annular lateral input and water-vapour stock-change contrasts on the same independently screened 79-SID subset. Lateral input is net exchange at 300 km minus that at 100 km; stock change is mass at 24 h minus that at 0 h. d, Mean net inward flux at 300 km at five post-departure times for each class (80 pairs). e,f, Discrete native pressure-interval contributions to net-transport contrasts (e) and outward-transport contrasts separated into symmetric humidity and relative-motion components (f). Each total in f equals . Panels a–c,e,f show paired differences; d shows class means. SIDs receive equal weight. Whiskers and shading are ordinary 95% percentiles from 2,000 paired-SID resamples, with common draws within a,b and shared primary transport identities in e,f. Tables S6b,g retain the intervals and counts for b and f; intervals crossing zero are retained.
